issues.detail: The Greek 'μετα ανομων ελογισθη' is in the passive voice (was counted/numbered), but the Vietnamese 'Ngài đã bị kể vào hàng kẻ dữ' implies a third person ('Ngài' - He/Him) was counted, whereas the Greek refers to the speaker ('ετι... εν εμοι' - this [thing] must be fulfilled in me). The Vietnamese phrasing makes it sound like someone else was counted as a sinner.
The word 'ετι' (yet/still) is present in the Greek but not explicitly captured in the Vietnamese translation of the first clause.
